label: VERIFIED
extraction: AutoGen (Microsoft) now in maintenance mode - no new features or enhancements, community managed. Users should migrate to Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) - enterprise-ready successor with stable APIs, long-term support, multi-provider model support, cross-runtime interoperability via A2A and MCP. Multi-agent orchestration via AgentTool: create AssistantAgent instances and wrap as AgentTool for orchestration. Example: AssistantAgent with code execution tool, UserProxyAgent, AgentTool for multi-agent setup. MAF provides production-ready multi-agent orchestration. Key shift: from AutoGen's conversation-centric model to MAF's enterprise-grade orchestration with A2A/MCP integration. AutoGen enabled next-gen LLM applications via multi-agent conversation (COLM 2024, arXiv:2308.08155).
